name: Carrot Salad with Walnuts, Raisins & Lemon-Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Wash, dry, and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Add oil, maple syrup, poppy seeds, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the raisins and carrots; stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
